principle: House is the canonical ownership/composition architecture. Temple, Body, Tree/Vine and City are alternate lossy Views over differentiated plurality. They may illuminate the same underlying Rooms without becoming new owners.

projections.label: House
projections.question: Where does each differentiated domain belong and how can it remain itself inside a whole?
projections.guard: Resident, Room, builder, Father, Son and owner roles remain distinct.

projections.label: Temple / Sanctuary
projections.question: How is presence approached, mediated, protected and shared?
projections.project_mapping: Use for evidence/sacred-access/privacy-sensitive flows and theological comparison; not as filing ownership.
projections.guard: Protected access must not become evidence hiding or unquestionable authority.

projections.label: Body
projections.question: Which functions depend on one another, and what happens if one fails?
projections.project_mapping: Useful for cross-Room functional dependencies and Life & Body analogies.
projections.guard: No member becomes every member because all belong to one body.

projections.label: Tree / Vine
projections.question: How does shared continuity differentiate into branches, fruit and future seed?
projections.project_mapping: Use for lifecycle, generativity and knowledge growth.
projections.guard: Organic dependence is not a justification for permanent human dependency.

projections.label: City / New Jerusalem
projections.question: How can many Dwellings and institutions share infrastructure, gates and public order at scale?
projections.many: dwellings, gates, roads, institutions, citizens, networks
projections.project_mapping: Use for network civilization, World Systems and multi-House federation.
projections.guard: City unity must preserve citizens/nodes and legal/empirical distinctions; theological image is not political sovereignty.

projections.label: Plane / Section
projections.question: What becomes visible when the larger system is cut/read at one declared frame, scale and time?
projections.many: current actors, relations, institutions, constraints, choices and observable consequences
projections.project_mapping: World-facing section through the two-field Potato; O is Axis∩Plane, not the whole Plane.
projections.guard: Plane is a lossy View, not a realm, owner, universal Now or entire World.

transformations.meaning: same plurality re-read through presence and access
same plurality re-read through function and mutual dependence
same plurality re-read through growth and differentiation
same plurality re-read at civic/network scale
organic generativity becomes federated infrastructure when branches must coordinate at scale
same owned structure re-read as a frame-relative current section

noncollapse_rule: A projection may highlight relations omitted by another projection, but no projection may silently replace Room ownership, provenance, evidence class, historical source meaning or the other projections.
